definitions.explanation: The state of being similar or alike in appearance, form, or nature. Used in both everyday and technical (especially mathematical) contexts.

definitions.gloss: similarity (in geometry); having the same shape but different size
definitions.explanation: A mathematical term describing geometric figures that have the same shape but may differ in scale. Two figures are similar if their corresponding angles are equal and sides are proportional.

examples.japanese: {親子|おやこ}が{相似|そうじ}している。
examples.english: The parent and child resemble each other.

examples.japanese: この{二|ふた}つの{事件|じけん}には{相似|そうじ}{点|てん}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: These two cases have many points of similarity.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{作風|さくふう}は{師匠|ししょう}のそれと{相似|そうじ}しているが、{独自|どくじ}の{個性|こせい}もある。
examples.english: His artistic style resembles that of his master, but he also has his own individuality.

examples.japanese: {相似|そうじ}な{三角形|さんかっけい}。
この{二|ふた}つの{図形|ずけい}は{相似|そうじ}の{関係|かんけい}にある。
examples.english: These two figures are in a relationship of similarity.

examples.japanese: {相似|そうじ}{比|ひ}が2:3なら、{面積比|めんせきひ}は4:9になる。
examples.english: If the similarity ratio is 2:3, then the area ratio is 4:9.

notes:
A compound of {相|そう} (mutual) + {似|じ} (resemble). Used across registers from everyday description to mathematical terminology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {相似|そうじ}している: to resemble each other
- {相似|そうじ}{点|てん}: point of similarity
- {相似|そうじ}{形|けい}: similar figure (geometry)
- {相似|そうじ}{比|ひ}: similarity ratio

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {類似|るいじ}: similarity — the more common general term for resemblance between things
- {似|に}ている: to resemble — the everyday verb for looking alike
- {酷似|こくじ}: striking resemblance — emphasizes very close similarity
- {合同|ごうどう}: congruence (geometry) — same shape AND same size
